item.title: Self-Hosted Web Development with Perl: Mojolicious vs Dancer2 vs Catalyst Framework Comparison (2026)
item.description: Despite decades of “Perl is dead” headlines, the Perl community continues to maintain and evolve several production-grade web frameworks. These frameworks power millions of sites and handle serious workloads — CPAN (the Comprehensive Perl Archive Network) remains one of the largest software repositories on the internet. If you’re building self-hosted web services and value stability, backwards compatibility, and battle-tested tooling, Perl’s web frameworks deserve a serious look.
